flags.effect: Hash of the plan to apply, as printed by library select plan (required)
flags.name: --plan-hash

flags.effect: Compare with the local clone instead of fetching the latest version
flags.name: --no-fetch

flags.effect: Also switch off the whole plugin that is installed beside the chosen items
flags.name: --switch

flags.effect: Comma list of rules whose Library folder may be replaced or removed although Toolport did not write it or it was edited since; write \, for a comma inside a name
flags.name: --force

flags.effect: Comma list of rules whose Library folder stays as it is; write \, for a comma inside a name
flags.name: --skip

summary: Apply a plan: generate the slice plugin of the chosen items, switch it on and install or remove the chosen rules in the Library (<source>, --plan-hash <hash>, --no-fetch, --switch, --force, --skip)
